launchGrantAndCurrentness.activation: Anyone may activate an exact grant only with the codehash-pinned reviewer ERC-1271 attestation over its exact EIP-712 grant digest and an Active registered profile.
launchGrantAndCurrentness.consumption: Only the exact launch wallet may atomically consume Active to Consumed after fixed typed graph and current-state validation. Any revert rolls back reservations, currentness use, and consumption.
launchGrantAndCurrentness.epochPolicy: Grant and Currentness securityControlHeadHash, security epoch/hash, policy epoch/hash and review generation/hash must equal current Registry and registered profile controls. Any drift requires a new profile identity where applicable, review, grant, currentness, winner nonce and derived winner key. Fresh currentness cannot revive an old grant.
launchGrantAndCurrentness.currentness: A separately reviewer-signed, revocable, one-use transport binds chain, registry, wallet, grant digest, plan, typed request, typed preflight aggregate, pre-sign Validator simulation evidence, exact service deployment identity, dual-provider quorum evidence, result, intent, current head/epochs/review generation and nonce. validAfter/deadline may span no more than 3600 seconds and is never an Applicant approval deadline.
launchGrantAndCurrentness.globalKill: Reviewer or governance can kill activation and consumption immediately. Clearing a set kill requires a strictly newer review generation plus a security or policy epoch advance; all pre-incident grants/currentness remain fail-closed.
launchGrantAndCurrentness.stateReadback: adoptionPreflightReadbackV1 is the side-effect-free typed consumer surface. It distinguishes chain/registry, all nine runtime classes, immutable runtime/authority binding, security/policy/review controls, kill/profile/grant/winner/currentness, graph/component/token/pool vacancy, receipt core and finality/indexing state without issuing a permit or creating an Applicant TTL. canonicalReceiptCore preserves the full immutable post-adoption core.

profileLifecycle.registration: One-time only. Re-registration is forbidden even after suspension or deprecation.
profileLifecycle.suspension: Reviewer or governance may suspend an active profile; activation and consumption both reject it. Suspension is terminal for that exact profile identity/version except for a final transition to Deprecated. It cannot return to Active.
profileLifecycle.rebindAfterSuspension: Recovery requires a separately registered profile identity/version plus a newly reviewed LaunchGrant and fresh currentness; pre-suspension grants/currentness cannot revive.
profileLifecycle.deprecation: Deprecated is terminal; finalized receipt records remain readable and immutable.
profileLifecycle.admission: DenyPendingReviewAndDeploymentEvidence cannot be registered as an active capability.

typedProvenance.createEvidence: Top-level CREATE evidence binds finalized tx hash/block/index, sender+nonce, to=zero, value, exact initcode input hash, receipt success, CREATE-derived topLevelCreatedAddress, finality and dual-provider evidence. CREATE nonce zero is valid.
requiredPerComponent: exact non-empty observed runtime code hash
configuration hash and source-bound creation evidence hash
canonical CREATE/CREATE2 provenance or an ExternalCanonical identifier
strictly ordered components and edges plus directed connectivity from component zero
typedProvenance.poolBinding: When the pool identity bit is set, PoolManager address/runtime, ExternalCanonical component index, pool ID, PoolKey hash and pool result hash are all nonzero and bound. A capability that requires a pool also pins the canonical chain-specific PoolManager address/runtime.
typedProvenance.applicationBinding: applicationHash must equal the exact Application component account/runtime/configuration commitment.
typedProvenance.create2Evidence: CREATE2 evidence binds the finalized outer transaction context, the top-level CREATE address when outer to=zero, component deployer+salt+initcode-derived account, and a nonzero internalCreationTraceHash. Nested constructor CREATE2 and shared/fixed factories are representable; authenticated trace/history verification remains an external activation prerequisite.

currentStateVerifier.binding: A registered codehash-pinned stateVerifier, state schema and nonzero behavior-evidence hash are mandatory. Onchain bytecode screening rejects DELEGATECALL; it does not claim to prove every CALL/STATICCALL forwarding dependency immutable.
currentStateVerifier.abi: verifyCurrentStateV1(registry, capability, plan, components, edges, request) returns exactly (architectureStateHash, poolStateHash, revenueStateHash).
currentStateVerifier.call: The Validator executes only this fixed selector using STATICCALL, at most 500000 gas and with a 200000 gas reserve. It requires exactly 96 bytes of returndata; revert, short, oversized or mismatched result fails closed.
currentStateVerifier.revenue: V1 requires plan/grant revenueBindingHash and request/verifier revenue state to be zero. No revenue activation is represented.

receiptAndFinality.prepared: Grant activation creates Prepared state and records the grant digest.
receiptAndFinality.adopted: Typed adoption anchors immutable CanonicalReceiptCoreV1 with grant digest/hash, currentness digest, plan hash, registered capability hash and typed request hash.
receiptAndFinality.identity: Finality/indexing records bind immutable receiptCoreHash and grant digest; no mutable URL or append can rewrite launch identity.

executionReadiness.constraintEquality: profile, plan and grant executionTimeConstraint and evidence hash must be exactly equal.
executionReadiness.sourceTimeConstraint: ExternalExecutionTimeBound is evidence only and has no execute route in this package.
executionReadiness.newSourceAnchor: A new source schedule anchor/deadline is a distinct reviewed plan, review, LaunchGrant and currentness; it must never be JIT-mutated under an existing grant.

dependencyRule.rule: Reviewer, governance, finality/indexer authorities, Codec, Validator, Preflight and profile state verifier require exact runtime codehashes and bytecode without DELEGATECALL. Because CALL/STATICCALL forwarding plus mutable storage cannot be proven generically from runtime alone, exact source/storage/control behavior evidence is mandatory before any non-null activation.

reason: This source-neutral package contains no Hookemon profile ID, deployment address, runtime hash, source revision, manifest, policy, evidence or activation.
A source-specific schedule anchor or execution deadline is evidence only here; it never creates an execution bypass.

requiredBeforeAnyAdoption: an explicit new reviewed COMPLETED_GRAPH_ADOPTION route/schema/profile rebind
a new exact plan with typed component graph, provenance, runtime/configuration, source and deployment evidence
a distinct purpose-bound LaunchGrant and fresh currentness

futureV4Activation.requirement: A future non-null v4 profile must machine-enforce chain-specific canonical PoolManager address/runtime plus full PoolKey and current slot/liquidity/fee state in its codehash-pinned typed verifier. An opaque contract-binding hash is insufficient.

forbiddenSurface: value, fund, transfer, approve or allowance execution
securityBoundary.allowedBytes: only the bounded reviewer ERC-1271 signature
fixedExternalCalls: bounded 32-byte ERC-1271 staticcall to the codehash-pinned reviewer authority
codehash-pinned typed stateVerifier fixed selector with exact 96-byte STATICCALL result

focusedValidation.forge: 36 focused tests passed; one winner-key property fuzzed for 10000 runs
coverage: evergreen Active grant succeeds years later only with fresh bounded currentness
revoked/consumed grants, currentness replay and nonce replay fail atomically
security/policy/review-generation drift rejects old grant even with fresh currentness
global kill and terminal profile suspension/deprecation prevent revival
winner key is derived from every required domain axis; identical concurrent domain has one winner
sourceLaunchId, stampLaunchId and antiReplayNonce are explicitly named, pairwise distinct in the Golden, and no equality condition exists
applicant/request, executable-source and carrier identities are separately grant-bound and cannot substitute for one another
review rebind requires a fresh terminal nonce/key domain and old grant remains terminal
typed state mutation, verifier revert/malformed return and PoolManager mismatch fail
typed preflight distinguishes runtime/control/profile/grant/winner/vacancy/replay/receipt/index state without signing or side effects
component runtime mutation changes the ordered preflight leaf and cannot consume the durable grant
missing pre-sign simulation, service deployment identity or dual-provider quorum evidence is retryable failure and does not consume the grant
candidate currentness digest used/revoked diagnostics are distinguishable but excluded from the signed snapshot to avoid circularity
ERC-1271 wrong magic, revert, short return and digest mutation fail
CREATE nonce-zero and outer-CREATE/nested-CREATE2 receipt+trace contexts are exact
shared component provenance/config identity cannot drift across plans
finality/indexing append without rewriting immutable receipt core
legacy custom-graph route cannot silently migrate

slitherHighSignal.result: No high/medium detector finding. Four low calls-loop notices are bounded by MAX_COMPONENTS=24 and invoke only exact codehash-pinned Codec or Registry readback paths; the state-changing Registry loop is nonReentrant and runs only after Validator success.

focusedValidation.manualSurfaceReview: No deployment, value, transfer, approval, arbitrary target, dynamic selector, opaque action bytes or delegatecall execution entry exists. This artifact does not claim deployment, approval or activation.

slitherFull.result: No independently reproducible high/medium safety finding. Remaining reports are intentional Solidity zero-default memory initialization, the bounded <=1h internal currentness transport timestamp, bounded ERC-1271/state-verifier assembly return handling, four capped/codehash-pinned calls-loop notices, and naming style.

preflight.providerPolicy: dualProviderQuorumEvidenceHash is a purpose-bound Authority attestation over two independent provider observations at one exact block identity; the contract never claims it queried providers

preflight.deploymentPolicy: serviceDeploymentBindingHash must bind the exact content-addressed Authority/API deployment; cache-only or provider-only state is insufficient
preflight.vacancyPolicy: zero graph/component/token/pool/index occupants before the first transaction is valid and expected; total=1 is a post-transaction dual-finality/indexing condition only
